overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board of Assessors and the other bodies did not improperly exclude the individual from meetings held June 14 to July 12, and the public bodies had already remedied the issue.

allegations.summary: Complaints alleged that Board of Assessors and other City Hall meetings from June 14 to July 12 were not accessible to the public after a no-trespass order barred one individual from City Hall.
allegations.key_passage: Based on the facts before us, we are unable to find that Mr. Branco was improperly excluded from any meeting held between June 14 and July 12.
